name: ng-postcode-mcp

tools.name: validate_postcode
tools.description:
Check a Nigerian postcode's structure offline; return its canonical forms and segments.

Free and instant. Does not confirm the code is assigned to a building; use
lookup_postcode for that.

postcode.description: Code in any style, e.g. 'ek 01 a03 fk 01'.
postcode.title: Postcode

tools.name: lookup_postcode
tools.description:
Confirm a postcode is assigned to a building. Free.

Address and building details are a paid lookup, listed as its own tool only when
the server's NG_POSTCODE_MAX_LEVEL is 2 or more.

postcode.description: Code in any style, e.g. EK-01-A03-FK-01.
postcode.title: Postcode

level.description: Always 1. Address and building details are a separate paid tool.
level.title: Level

tools.name: autocomplete_postcode
tools.description:
Suggest the next segment of a partly typed Nigerian postcode. Free.

Use it while a user is still typing or only knows the start of their code. For a
complete code, use validate_postcode, then lookup_postcode.

partial.description: The start of a code, e.g. 'EK 01 A'.
partial.title: Partial

tools.name: find_postcode_at_location
tools.description:
Return the postcode of the nearest building to a coordinate in Nigeria.

Names and the house address are withheld unless NG_POSTCODE_MAX_LEVEL is 2 or more.

max_distance_m.description: Search radius in metres. Defaults to 25.
max_distance_m.title: Max Distance M

instructions:
Tools for Nigeria's 11-character building postcode, e.g. EK-01-A03-FK-01 (state, LGA, district, area, building unit).
- validate_postcode is offline and free: use it first on any code a user typed.
- lookup_postcode confirms a code is assigned to a building, and is free.
- Never substitute a suggested correction without confirming it with the user.
- Addresses returned are personal data: use them only for the user's request.
